scope: C vs C-shared-target, final600; two orders; 20 states; clean + four frozen new backgrounds
sequence: freeze -> inventory -> validation -> clean pairs -> background pairs
time: control step 1 = first post-action state; video frame k is pre-action at zero-based control 8*k; 20Hz control,2.5fps video

existing_proxies.goal: recorded height AND contact AND xy<0.03; original success label retained

new_descriptive_rules.basis: 3cm uses existing target-centering tolerance;5cm fixed sensitivity;8 steps is one deployed chunk, not optimized for outcomes

candidate_rules: post-lift first open while outside xy goal
post-lift finger-contact loss before goal (contact is not stable grasp truth)
post-lift outward XY change >=3cm (sensitivity5cm) during at least8 consecutive bowl-descending intervals
center entered then lost before goal
EE re-approach: near->far->near using existing0.10m threshold, not confirmed regrasp
video_selection: one per order x outcome group; conditions in clean,bg1,bg2,bg3,bg4 order then ascending state; empty groups not replaced; at most8 pairs
intervals: none; descriptive census; no independence claims
